## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request title is a Conventional Commit (`feat(mail): …`,
      `fix: …`, `docs: …`; at most 72 characters): it becomes the commit
      message when the pull request is merged.
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and I ran the checks (`npm run check`) and the
      test suites that cover it (`docs/dev-setup.md`, "Test").
- [ ] User-visible texts are in the Fluent catalogs, styling in the theme
      (`CLAUDE.md`).
- [ ] I have read the contributor license agreement in
      [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and accept it for this and my
      later contributions.
